tagline: Sunrise runs, dumpling crawls, bad puns.

chat.text: Hey, I'm your Wingmate. Let's start easy: tell me about yourself and what a good week looks like.
I'm a product designer who lives for the weekend. A good week has two trail runs, one night out with friends, and nothing on my calendar Sunday evening.
Nice. What do your weekends usually look like?
Saturdays I'm on the trail before 7 most Saturdays with my dog Biscuit, then a slow brunch. Sundays are board games or a jazz set somewhere in the Fillmore.
Food is a big signal. What are you always down to eat?
Dumplings, always. I will cross the city for a good soup dumpling and I'm slowly working through every xiao long bao spot in the Richmond.
What else do you do to move, make, or unwind?
Besides running I love board games, Wingspan especially, and live jazz on a weeknight when I can swing it.
How's work, and does it leave you energy for dating?
Work is busy but reasonable, around 45 hours. I have energy for dating if the plans are low-key.
What's your relationship with drinking?
I have a glass of wine or a beer when I'm out, maybe twice a week, never more than a couple.
Any smoking, vaping or similar I should know about, for you or in a match?
Smoking is the one thing I can't do. I really can't date someone who smokes, my dad had COPD for years. I don't smoke or vape myself.
How do you feel about having kids someday?
I honestly don't know if I want kids, ask me again in a year. I'm open if it's the right person.
Pets? A dog, a cat, allergies, none?
I have a dog, Biscuit, a beagle mix who comes on every run. Dog people get bonus points.
How important are religion or spirituality to you, and what values matter most?
Religion isn't important to me, but I care a lot about kindness and showing up for people.
Morning person or night owl?
I'm up at 5:45 every day and fading by ten. Night owls, I'll be the one yawning at your show.
What are you hoping to find in a partner?
I want someone curious and outdoorsy who would happily split a plate of dumplings and doesn't take themselves too seriously.
Any hard dealbreakers I should screen for?
Smoking, like I said. Otherwise I'm flexible, I just want someone kind.
Last one: when are you free for a first date this coming week?
Saturday evening around six works, Sunday late morning is great, and Tuesday after seven. Thanksgiving week gets hectic.
Thanks, that's plenty to work with. I'll look for matches quietly and keep your private details private until you both opt in.
